title: 1904 alley poles and wires no longer run through coach houses
items: Ten utility poles in the alleys behind Prairie Avenue and Calumet Avenue now stand a little further into the alley, so the poles, their crossarms and their wires clear the coach houses and stables on the alley line, Glessner's stable among them.
The wire that ran from Glessner's pole on 18th Street over the corner of his stable into the alley is gone; that alley's line is fed across 18th Street from the alley to the north.
No pole, crossarm or wire in the 1904 scene now touches a building.
